layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Giant sauropod size comparison
features: A full-body side view of a massive, long-necked Brachiosaurus-style dinosaur made of teal-colored clay
Standing next to the dinosaur's front leg is a small, simple clay figure of a child in bright orange
The dinosaur is towering, with its head near the top of the frame to emphasize its gargantuan scale
Clean, minimalist clay sculpts with smooth surfaces and gentle rounded edges
The child figure is used as a scale bar to show how 'Big' the dinosaur is
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic wide shot on a seamless off-white studio background. The composition is clean and focused on the contrast in height between the tiny child and the giant dinosaur. No text.
